item.title: Laser Dance Gets First Major Content Update Today
item.description: Quest 3 mixed reality game Laser Dance adds two new challenge modes in its first major content update.

item.title: Made-For-VR Raceclub Arrives On Quest In Early Access Today
item.description: Raceclub, a new, made-for-VR racing game released today on Quest in early access.

item.title: Thief Simulator VR: Heist Crew Sneaks on Meta Quest Soon
item.description: Thief Simulator VR: Heist Crew promises to build on the best parts of its predecessor with procedural generation and chaotic multiplayer.

item.title: Zombie Army VR To Lose Co-Op Gameplay Next Month
item.description: Zombie Army VR will lose co-op multiplayer next month, with the developer blaming a change with Unity's hosting services.

item.title: Blade And Sorcery: Nomad 'Sentara' Update Out Now
item.description: The free 'Sentara' update adds a new faction, new weapons, armor, and lore, plus a new map to explore in the game's sandbox and Crystal Hunt modes.

item.title: The Midnight Walk Gets Permanent Price Drop on Steam and PlayStation
item.description: The Midnight Walk, a grim and beautiful adventure using a claymation art style, gets a strong discount on Steam and PlayStation VR2.

item.title: How To Make Your Quest 3 A Great Travel-Ready Spatial Computer
item.description: From the latest browser upgrades to Meta’s new Surface Keyboard, here's how your Quest 3 can become a portable spatial computer for home or travel.

item.title: Pico's Next Headset Has 4K Micro-OLEDs, Powerful New Chip & Next-Gen OS
item.description: ByteDance's Pico announced the key display and compute specs of its next headset, coming later this year, and detailed the revamped XR operating system it will run.

item.title: Raceclub Impressions: Just One More Lap
item.description: Raceclub is a made-for-VR love letter to formula racing that has you literally chasing ghosts in a promising, addictive work-in-progress.

item.title: Arizona Sunshine Remake & The Pirate: Republic of Nassau Are Quest's Horizon+ Monthly Games This March
item.description: Arizona Sunshine Remake and The Pirate: Republic of Nassau are the Horizon+ monthly games on Quest for March.
